info.name: NCBI Datasets BioSample Virus API
Virus
Get a download summary of a virus genome data package by taxon

params.name: accessions
params.description: One or more nucleotide sequence accessions

params.name: taxon
params.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID or name (common or scientific) at any taxonomic rank

params.name: refseq_only
params.description: If true, limit results to RefSeq genomes.

params.name: annotated_only
params.description: If true, limit results to annotated genomes.

params.name: host
params.description: Limit to genomes isolated from the specified host species (NCBI Taxonomy ID, common or scientific name).

params.name: pangolin_classification
params.description: Limit to SARS-CoV-2 genomes from the specified Pango lineage.

params.name: geo_location
params.description: Limit to genomes collected from the specified geographic location.

params.name: usa_state
params.description: Limit to genomes collected from the specified U.S. state (two-letter abbreviation).

params.name: complete_only
params.description: Limit to genomes designated as complete, as defined by the submitter.

params.name: include_sequence
params.description: Specify which sequence files to include in the data package.

params.name: aux_report
params.description: Specify which report files to include in the data package. The virus data report is always included, and its inclusion is not affected by this parameter.

info.name: Get a virus data report by taxon

params.name: taxon
params.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID or name (common or scientific) at any taxonomic rank

params.name: filter.refseq_only
params.description: If true, limit results to RefSeq genomes.

params.name: filter.annotated_only
params.description: If true, limit results to annotated genomes.

params.name: filter.host
params.description: Limit to genomes isolated from the specified host species (NCBI Taxonomy ID, common or scientific name).

params.name: filter.pangolin_classification
params.description: Limit to SARS-CoV-2 genomes from the specified Pango lineage.

params.name: filter.geo_location
params.description: Limit to genomes collected from the specified geographic location.

params.name: filter.usa_state
params.description: Limit to genomes collected from the specified U.S. state (two-letter abbreviation).

params.name: filter.complete_only
params.description: Limit to genomes designated as complete, as defined by the submitter.

params.name: returned_content
params.description: Return complete virus reports or nucleotide accessions only

params.name: table_fields
params.description: Specify which fields to include in the tabular report

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of virus data reports to return. Default is 20 and maximum is 1000. If the number of results exceeds the page size, `page_token` can be used to retrieve the remaining results.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A page token is returned when the results count exceeds `page size`. Use this token along with previous request parameters to retrieve the next page of results. When `page_token` is empty, all results have been retrieved.

items.docs: Get a virus data report by taxon. By default, in paged JSON format, but also available in tabular (accept: text/tab-separated-values) or JSON Lines (accept: application/x-ndjson) formats.
